editorial.blurb: Moody's Pub is an honest, unpretentious neighborhood spot where a simple one-page menu, quality burgers, and the kind of worn-wood charm you can't fake make for genuine good times.
editorial.insiderTip: Order your fries well-done for maximum crispiness, grab a beer by the pitcher or stein, and claim a seat in the patio area—it's the heart of this place, especially for groups.

topDishes.note: Fresh-cut and remarkably crispy, especially when ordered well-done
Juicy and flavorful with creative cheese options under fifteen dollars
